autonomous_timing.interpretation: Measured autonomous rollout cost includes failure prefixes and lagged-risk initialization. Fixed policy order, evolving policy-dependent geometry/edge counts, differing failed lengths and warmup scope prevent a controlled speedup conclusion. Use separately measured same-state repeated timings for placement/runtime claims.
